name: Entry-square census
method: tr(M^T M) equals the sum of squares of all entries; count assignments of {0,1,2} or {-1,0,1} hitting the target sum.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 2 verified examples in Matrices and Determinants; not exhaustive.

name: Cramer numerators plus rank check
method: D vanishes identically; Dx = Dy = Dz = 0 pin the parameter; row-dependence check confirms infinite solutions.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 2 verified examples in Matrices and Determinants; not exhaustive.

name: Block-diagonal power closed form
method: Split into 2x2 plus scalar blocks; the 2x2 block forces the linear relation, the scalar block fixes the constants.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 1 verified example in Matrices and Determinants; not exhaustive.

name: Determinant-zero case split
method: Compute the coefficient determinant; nonzero means unique solution, zero drops into consistency analysis (no-solution vs infinite).
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 6 verified examples in Matrices and Determinants; not exhaustive.

name: Tangent condition algebra
method: Substitute y = mx + c (or the T = 0 form) into the curve and force the discriminant to zero; read off the constant.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 6 verified examples in Co-ordinate Geometry; not exhaustive.

name: Parameter elimination to locus
method: Parametrize the moving point (midpoint, foot, intersection), eliminate the parameter against the curve equation.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 3 verified examples in Co-ordinate Geometry; not exhaustive.

name: Fringe-width inversion
method: Read fringe or extremum positions off the setup, invert beta = lambda D / d (or nth-minimum spacing) for the unknown.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 4 verified examples in Optics; not exhaustive.

name: Two-step image chaining
method: Propagate the image of the first element as the object of the second (including virtual objects); retrace arguments for coincidence setups.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 3 verified examples in Optics; not exhaustive.

name: Range and height ratios
method: Separate horizontal (uniform) and vertical (accelerated) motion; ratios cancel the launch speed.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 2 verified examples in Kinematics; not exhaustive.

name: van't Hoff factor inversion
method: Back out i from boiling-point elevation, then read the ionisation state off i against the formula-unit ion count.
coverage_note: Initial mapping: 2 verified examples in Solutions; not exhaustive.
